Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team at HorizonHealth is excited to move to contract. Procurement asked that we get an MSA redline call and an evidence handoff scheduled before they issue the PO.

Would you be able to do a 2-hour kickoff next week where we:

- Do a short run through of the onboarding evidence checklist (SOC2, retention policies, audit logs)
- Agree on next steps for signatures/PO issuance

We can do any of these windows (PST):
- Tue 23 Mar, 10:00–12:00
- Wed 24 Mar, 13:00–15:00
- Thu 25 Mar, 09:00–11:00

If a single two-hour block is tight, we could split, but procurement prefers minimal back-and-forth.

Attached is a short vendor intake note from our side. Let me know what works and who from Redwood should join (legal, procurement ops).

Thanks,

Hi Priya — really appreciate the clarity here. Quick note from my side: a tightly focused two-hour meeting can work but we find better outcomes when the redline review and evidence handoff are slightly separated so legal can focus on contract text while our onboarding ops run through evidence independently. Proposal from Redwood:

Option A (recommended):
- 45-minute MSA redline slot with Redwood legal present (we'll bring Rishi)
- 30-minute evidence walk-through with onboarding ops (Marissa + Monica)
- Leave 15–30 minutes buffer same day or next day for follow-ups / DocuSign Q&A

Option B (if procurement insists on one meeting):
- 2-hour single session, with clear agenda (first 60 min redline, 45 min evidence, 15 min next steps)

Tentative availability (PST):
- Wed 24 Mar: 09:00–12:00 (we can do redline at 09:00, evidence at 10:00)
- Thu 25 Mar: 11:00–14:00

I've attached a recommended agenda and an evidence checklist to speed things up. Can you confirm:
- Which of the above windows works best?
- Will procurement want to join the redline, or only the PO owner later?
- Any mandatory attendees from Horizon legal who must be on the redline call?

If you confirm Option A, we'll send two calendar invites (one for legal redline, one for evidence handoff).

Thanks — looping in Marissa and Monica on ops.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com
